suppress.notes: CVE-2018-1258 affects only Spring Framework 5.0.5 used together with Spring Security (method-security authorization bypass). The NVD entry matches any spring-security version by CPE, so every Spring Security jar is flagged. This project runs Spring Framework 7.0.10 (spring-core, spring-beans, spring-context, spring-webmvc 7.0.10 in the backend runtime classpath).
